_README: Source-digest for scripts/build_structural_trajectories.py. Each driver entry lists per-key knot rates with a value-level source citation + confidence, so trajectories_v{N}.json is REPRODUCIBLE (build --check gates it). The driver values here are EXTRACTED FROM REAL SOURCES by scripts/extract_structural_sources.py (run it to rebuild from data/structural/sources/raw/): PWT 10.01, UN WPP 2024, ILOSTAT LFPR, EU KLEMS 2024 growth-accounts workbook, NGFS Phase 5. NOT illustrative. Documented limits (single-country EU KLEMS = Austria; NGFS economy-wide; forward knots = recent trend held flat; N/S+BRD/MIL archetypes) are tracked in docs/structural-data-pipeline-plan.md (1a-breadth, 1c-1e).

provenance.source: PWT 10.01 (productivity) + UN WPP 2024 (population) + ILOSTAT LFPR (participation) + EU KLEMS & INTANProd 2024 release (sector MFP via LP1ConTFP, per-hour LP, labour share) + NGFS Phase 5 REMIND-MAgPIE 3.3-4.8 / Below 2C (emissions intensity = CO2/GDP)
provenance.licence: see per-entry sources; UN WPP: CC BY 3.0 IGO, PWT 10.01: CC BY 4.0, ILOSTAT: CC BY 4.0, EU KLEMS: CC BY 4.0, NGFS: see NGFS terms
provenance.notes: Per-region and per-sector annual growth trajectories for the Phase 7b.2 structural drivers, EXTRACTED FROM REAL SOURCES by scripts/extract_structural_sources.py and assembled by scripts/build_structural_trajectories.py (both have --check gates in CI). v3 (review-8 2026-09-09): EU KLEMS uses the workbook's per-hour TFP contribution LP1ConTFP directly as the sourced 'mfp' driver (was a dimensionally-wrong LP2_G/CAP_QI decomposition — LP2_G is VA per PERSON, not per hour; capital_deepening driver retired for EU KLEMS); NGFS scenario is an explicit validated tuple (Below 2C); global __all__ aggregates are member-weighted (not means of archetypes); rates are proportional (log/delta-log sources converted via expm1). Rates are decimal fractions per year; the wrapper holds the most recent knot piecewise-constant. N (advanced) / S (emerging) region + BRD (goods) / MIL (services) sector archetypes, plus a global __all__. Per-value source strings carry geography/release/sheet/window/transform. Known limits (single-country EU KLEMS, NGFS economy-wide, held-flat forward knots, participation LOW confidence) are documented in docs/structural-data-pipeline-plan.md.

N.source: UN World Population Prospects 2024, Total Population (both sexes), Medium variant; annual growth pop[y+1]/pop[y]−1 at knots 2025/2035/2050; population-weighted over mapped countries per N/S archetype. https://population.un.org/wpp/

S.source: UN World Population Prospects 2024, Total Population (both sexes), Medium variant; annual growth pop[y+1]/pop[y]−1 at knots 2025/2035/2050; population-weighted over mapped countries per N/S archetype. https://population.un.org/wpp/

S.source: ILOSTAT indicator EAP_DWAP_SEX_AGE_RT (labour-force participation rate), SEX_T total, AGE_AGGREGATE_YGE15 (15+) band; per-country annualised log-trend over the recent ≤10-year window (latest obs ≥2015), expm1→proportional, clipped ±1%/yr; UNWEIGHTED archetype mean, held forward. LOW confidence: no labour-force size weights, single recent trend projected flat. https://ilostat.ilo.org/
